document.note: Local content-addressed manifest. Not stage7 authenticated export. No external key, cross-service cursor, watermark, or retention duration. retention_policy names five empty slots, each with an owner and a status of UNDETERMINED or DECISION_REQUIRED; no duration, bound, or timer is set, and the simulation retains every record with no automatic deletion (RETAIN_ALL_NO_AUTOMATIC_DELETION). Data classes journal, receipts, case_fixtures, derived_views, export_manifests, dev_hmac_key, and test_and_ci_artifacts hold no personal data by design (NO_PERSONAL_DATA_BY_DESIGN_V1). SignaturePort is the adoption seam. A shared HMAC key is integrity only, not authentication.
